rows.learningTarget: Allegan County was split between MI-2 and MI-6 in 2022.
rows.finding: 117th directory lists Allegan (part) for Huizenga MI-2 and Upton MI-6.
rows.review_note: Historical content supported; distinguish 117th district map from subsequent boundaries.

rows.learningTarget: Barr's official biography identifies him as Senator-elect after the 2026 election, while the 119th House listing and Clerk profile identify his KY-6 service; Senate term is not assumed to have begun.
rows.finding: Official biography identifies Barr as Senator-elect; Clerk lists incumbent KY-6 in 119th Congress.
rows.review_note: Supported as of review date; do not infer Senate term has started.

rows.learningTarget: House.gov explains that new 2026 congressional maps are for the next Congress and existing districts apply until January 2027.
rows.finding: House FAQ explicitly distinguishes election maps from current boundaries through January 2, 2027; new Congress January 2027.
rows.review_note: Supported; avoid implying all districts were redrawn.

rows.learningTarget: Pelosi congratulated Scott Wiener on his CA-11 election on November 4, 2026; a regular election does not immediately terminate the incumbent's term.
rows.finding: November 4 statement congratulates Wiener; Clerk still lists Pelosi as CA-11 incumbent.

rows.learningTarget: South Dakota began using three numbered House districts in 1913.
rows.finding: State legislative manual printed p.103 identifies three numbered districts and Dillon, Burke, Martin in 1913; 63rd Congress historical profile supports period.
rows.review_note: Core count supported; manual extracted text used; PDF screenshot failed due to file size. Portrait rights not assessed.

rows.learningTarget: Elizabeth Kee filled the vacancy caused by John Kee's death in 1951.
rows.finding: Elizabeth Kee won July 17, 1951 special election after death of John Kee; Cotton served in House 1947–1954.
rows.review_note: Supported. Phrase 'new term' should mean service in remainder of existing congressional term, not a new full term.

rows.learningTarget: Stephanie Herseth entered the House through the June 2004 special election.
rows.finding: Herseth won June 1, 2004 special election after Janklow resigned January 20; sworn June 3; Thune's House service ended January 3, 2003.
rows.review_note: Supported. Thune is former representative in this fictional meeting; no new full congressional term began.

rows.learningTarget: Sires filled Menendez's House vacancy through a special election in 2006.
rows.finding: Menendez resigned January 16, 2006; Sires won November 7 special election to fill vacancy.
rows.review_note: Supported. Specify remainder of 109th Congress, not a new full term; portrait rights not assessed.

limitations: Historical review only; no Q4 change applied, no I1 approval or full-axis clearance. Fictional meeting dates and portrait rights not certified.
